page.overview:
Who is Narmacil I?

Narmacil I was the seventeenth King of Gondor after the death of his father Atanatar II Alcarin in TA 1226. Like Tarannon Falastur before him, he was notable for his childlessness.

Narmacil was born in the year TA 1049 to Atanatar II and his unnamed wife. He was as lazy as his father and was soon tired of being king. Intending to pursue his own personal pleasures and activities, he created the office of Regent and surrendered practical rule to his nephew Minalcar by TA 1240 (who would eventually become king in his own right).

During his reign, the Easterlings started to become a threat again and his regent's main concern was making alliance with the tribes of the Northmen to help fight against them. Narmacil died childless in TA 1294 after reigning sixty four years and ruling for fourteen, he was succeeded by his brother Calmacil.
